prompt: Large quantities of plastic waste end up in the world's oceans every year. What do you think are the main reasons for this, and what could be done to address the situation?
essay:
It is true that a huge amount of the plastic waste is going to the ocean every year and this is a very serious problem for our planet. In this essay, I am going to analyse the main reasons of this problem and also give some possible solutions.

There are several reasons for this problem. Firstly, people use too much plastic in their daily life. For example, when we go to the supermarket, everything is packed in the plastic, and we also buy the water in plastic bottles. Secondly, many people throw the rubbish in the street or in the river instead of the dustbin, and after that the rain carry this rubbish to the sea. Moreover, in some developing countries there is not a good system of the waste management, so the rubbish is not collected properly and it goes to the environment.

However, this problem can be solved. Firstly, the government should ban the plastic bags and make a fine for the people who throw the rubbish in the street. Secondly, we should recycle more, because recycling is very good for the environment and it can reduce this problem a lot. In addition, the schools and the media should make awareness about this problem, so people will understand and they will change their habit.

In conclusion, the main reasons of this problem are the excessive use of the plastic, the bad habits of the people and the poor waste management, and it can be solved by the ban, the recycling and the awareness. Everybody should work together to save our ocean.
title: Plastic waste reaching the oceans
